Corollary
[Ricci-flat obstruction for sphere products]

Source: petersen:page-0319 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-splitting-theorem 1. ch7:7.3.10$S^k\times S^1$ admits no Ricci-flat metric when $k=2,3$.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch7-no-ricci-flat-sphere-product \sketch The universal cover is $S^k\times \mathbb R$, which is disconnected at infinity; the splitting theorem therefore gives a Ricci-flat compact simply connected $k$-manifold homotopy equivalent to $S^k$. For $k=2,3$ it is flat, contradicting the fundamental group of a compact flat manifold.

□
